name: easyacco
//engines: Pinned to match .nvmrc and the node-version in both workflows. A test suite verified on a different major than CI runs is not verified: jsdom 30 imports undici 8, which calls node:worker_threads.markAsUncloneable — added in Node 22 and undefined in Node 20. It passed locally and failed CI.
//build: Builds with webpack, not Turbopack. next.config.ts used to carry an empty `turbopack` block and a comment claiming the opposite; the block did nothing and the comment was wrong, so both are gone. Moving the production build to Turbopack is a real change that needs its own verification pass — it is not a config tweak.
//scripts.lint: Deliberately unscoped so root-level config files are linted too. The directories that makes eslint walk are named in eslint.config.mjs's globalIgnores, because flat config does not read .gitignore.
//overrides: Both entries force a patched version of a transitive dependency that Next
pins below the fix. Neither is a direct dependency of this app, so there is
no other way to clear them and `npm audit fix --force` 'resolves' them by
installing next@9.3.3 — a six-major-version downgrade, which is not a fix.
GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 — sourceMappingURL path traversal and stringify XSS).
8.5.x is semver-compatible with 8.4.x. It runs at build time only.
sharp: Next declares ^0.34.5 as an OPTIONAL dependency for next/image.
0.34.x inherits four libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj); 0.35.0 is the fix.
This app imports next/image nowhere, so the optimiser is unexercised and the
override cannot regress a rendering path we use.
Duplicated under `pnpm.overrides` because Vercel and CI install with pnpm,
which ignores the npm-format `overrides` block. Keep the two in step.
